description: Explicitly capture one exact registered URL in the configured existing project, without a model or AI pins, and return its private canonical app review after exact readback. Requires current owner/editor access and an installed sandboxed browser. Supply a stable UUIDv4 operationId before starting; repeating that ID only reads the recorded outcome and never repeats uploads or report minting. Does not create projects, invite members, or publish public shares.

operationId.description: Stable lowercase UUIDv4 for this explicit command. Reuse this value after a lost response; use a new ID only for a separately requested capture.

projectId.description: Must equal the MCP configured project and currently permit owner/editor writes.

requireAuth.description: Require capture evidence of authenticated browser state; no login is performed by this tool.

url.description: Exact registered URL. Captures this page only, with desktop and mobile evidence.
